partially_covered.missing: Ontology provides Organization and Address, but lacks explicit properties for organization-specific information beyond address (e.g., contact details, identifiers).
ItemDetail class exists, but lacks concrete data properties (e.g., item description, specification) to fully answer the question.
No explicit modeling of file format validity constraints or required fields; only structural constraints are present.

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are directly supported by the ontology's classes and properties. Some CQs (5, 8, 13) lack full support due to missing data properties or explicit constraints for required information.

strengths: Functional and inverse properties correctly modeled
weaknesses: No general class axioms (GCAs) for complex definitions
Some classes (e.g., ItemDetail, InvoiceDetail) are underdeveloped

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4 (Missing domain or range in some properties, though not observed here)
P7 (Flat hierarchy; subclasses could be introduced for roles, message types, etc.)

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add data properties to Organization (e.g., hasName, hasContact, hasIdentifier) and ItemDetail (e.g., hasDescription, hasSpecification) to fully answer CQ5 and CQ8.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Full CQ coverage; users can retrieve all organization and item information.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model required data properties and cardinality constraints for Invoice and EDIFACTMessage (e.g., make hasInvoiceNumber and hasInvoiceAmount mandatory with owl:minCardinality 1) to address CQ13.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Ontology will specify validity criteria for file format.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce subclasses for OrganizationRole (e.g., Buyer, Seller) and Item (e.g., Product, Service) for a deeper hierarchy.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves hierarchy depth and semantic clarity.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add general class axioms (GCAs) to define, for example, Buyer as an OrganizationRole that is linked to an Invoice via hasBuyer.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables reasoning over roles and supports more complex queries.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Provide more example individuals and usage scenarios in the ontology.

summary: The ontology provides strong coverage for the EDIFACT scenario and most competency questions, with solid use of reification, restrictions, and annotations. However, some CQs require additional data properties and explicit cardinality constraints for full support. The class hierarchy could be deepened and general class axioms introduced for more advanced reasoning.
